text:
sam: Morning — quick debrief from last night's page (incident 2026-115). I tried the handoff bot tweaks we talked about but found gaps:

sam: 1) bot didn't capture customer-impact details, we had to ask the pager several times.
sam: 2) actions baked into the PM template aren't getting synced to the action board (they appear as text only).
sam: 3) follow-up meeting scheduling is manual and sometimes missed.

ops-bot: Incident 2026-115 assigned to @sam (sev2) — Pager: paged 23:47 UTC

alex: +1. We should capture a quick `customer_impact` enum at page time: none / partial / complete. Minimal friction — single char capture.
alex: Example: `impact=C|P|N` in the paging response.

priya: Drafted a small post-incident template we can ship to the handoff-bot. Putting it here for bikeshedding:

priya: ```
incident_id: 2026-115
sev: 2
start_ts: 2026-06-14T23:42Z
customer_impact: P
summary: brief one-line
actions:
  - id: A1
    owner: @maria
    due: 2026-06-17
    title: increase request timeout on inference-proxy
notes: capture console logs, trace IDs
``` 

priya: And the bot command to create a follow-up ticket:
priya: `/handoff create --incident 2026-115 --template post-incident-v2 --capture impact` 

jordan: For the action board: can we auto-create rows via webhook? Example CSV header I'd like:

jordan: `incident_id, action_id, owner, status, due_date, jira_link, notes`

maria: I can take a 2-day spike to wire the bot -> action-board flow. Plan:
- add `customer_impact` capture prompt during page
- POST new actions to /api/actions (auth via service token)
- include `action_id` in handoff message so the bot can update status later

maria: volunteers :raised_hands:

oncall-bot: Scheduled follow-up: incident-2026-115 postmortem sync set for 2026-06-16 16:00 UTC. Attendees: @sam @maria @alex @priya

sam: Perfect. Goals for the spike:
- ensure `customer_impact` is stored with the incident record
- ensure actions appear on the dashboard with owner + due
- implement a `/handoff update-action A1 --status done` command

alex: Small UX ask: when action created, bot should return a compact link like `https://console/redwood/actions/A1` and a short markdown summary we can paste into the postmortem doc.

priya: One more idea — lightweight severity->impact mapping so on-call doesn't need to think: if `affected_customers>0` and `latency_pct>10%` then default impact=P. Can be off by toggling.

sam: Good. Who wants to own the PR for the bot? O(2d) spike + 1 week to production.

maria: I'll own the spike. Will create a draft RFC in #eng-architecture and a proof-of-concept branch.

alex: :thumbsup: Thanks. Let's also add a retention check so old unresolved actions surface in weekly ops review.

ops-bot: Note: created followup ticket #INC-2026-115-F1 — owner=@maria — due=2026-06-17

sam: Great thread. If anyone has other tiny wins (keyboard shortcuts, better default templates), drop them here and I'll fold into the RFC. :eyes:
